senses.gloss: f. (הדר; v. הַדְרָנָא) swindler, a woman who sells property and afterwards reclaims it on a mortgage held by herself.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 97a:9">Keth. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>דלא ליקרו לה ה׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="E00161"><he>הדרינתא</he></cite>) that they may not call her a swindler.
